prompt: Add two fields to checkout: a required "Phone number", with the help text "Our delivery driver calls this number. Include the country code, for example +420.", and an optional "Delivery notes" text area. Also make it clear which of the existing fields (Full name, Email, Street and number, City, Postal code, Country) must be filled in; all of them must. Write it in React, no new packages. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
